keyword: why is the stock market closed today
claims: The U.S. stock market (NYSE and Nasdaq) is closed on Friday, April 3, 2026, in observance of Good Friday.
Good Friday is a recognized holiday for the stock exchanges.
The tradition of closing the stock exchanges for Good Friday dates back to the late 19th century.
The U.S. bond market is not closed completely on Good Friday.
The U.S. bond market holds an abbreviated session on Good Friday.
The U.S. bond market closes at noon ET on Good Friday.
Good Friday is not a federal holiday.
Regular trading hours for the NYSE and Nasdaq resume on Monday, April 6, 2026, at 9:30 a.m. ET.
The next scheduled market closure is on Monday, May 25, 2026, for Memorial Day
